title: Tech support scam: "Microsoft" says the computer has a virus

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is Kevin from Microsoft Windows support. We got an alert that your computer is sending out viruses.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Oh my goodness, I didn't know that.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Don't worry, I can fix it right now. Please go to your computer and download the app called QuickHelp so I can connect to it.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: I'm not very good with computers.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's okay, I'll do everything. Once I'm connected, there's a one-time security fee of $399. You can pay with a Google Play gift card.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please don't turn off the computer or hang up, or the hackers will steal your bank information today.
